name: CSS - Advanced Styling
description: Create a complete styled webpage with advanced CSS

rules.text: Create a navigation bar with class-based styling
rules.hint: Create: <nav class="navbar"><a href="#">Home</a><a href="#">About</a></nav> and style: .navbar a { text-decoration: none; padding: 10px; }

rules.text: Add hover effects to your navigation links
rules.hint: Make links interactive: .navbar a:hover { background-color: lightblue; }. The :hover pseudo-class triggers when mouse hovers.

rules.text: Create a card with rounded corners and shadow
rules.hint: Add: <div class="card">Card content</div> and style: .card { border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); padding: 20px; }

completion.message: 🎉 Congratulations! You've mastered CSS fundamentals! JavaScript levels are now unlocked! You've earned bonus XP for completing all CSS levels!
